comparisons.target: state-space covariance vs direct transfer-function quadrature

comparisons.reference: source Figure 16 visual scale and printed Eqs. (16)-(18)

discrepancies.observation: For the same numerical S0, the source figure display corresponds to the positive-frequency integral while the printed two-sided integral is exactly twice that value.
discrepancies.engineering_interpretation: Keep both conventions explicit. Do not tune S0 or silently relabel the source figure until source sampling/PSD convention is resolved.

limitations: The source Figure 16 scale and printed two-sided integral differ by a factor of two for the same numerical S0.
Exact source sampling and PSD convention remain unclosed.
No FE model is reproduced; this is an independent non-FE equation evaluation.
Copyrighted source PDF/raster are external; expected SHA-256 is preserved.
